scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p .sass-cache public/css/themes public/js && cp nitter/src/sass/include/_mixins.css .sass-cache/_mixins.scss && sass --load-path=.sass-cache --load-path=nitter/src/sass/include --no-source-map --silence-deprecation=import --silence-deprecation=global-builtin nitter/src/sass/index.scss public/css/style.css && cp nitter/public/css/fontello.css public/css/fontello.css && rm -f public/css/themes/*.css public/js/*.js && cp nitter/public/css/themes/*.css public/css/themes/ && cp nitter/public/js/hls.min.js nitter/public/js/hlsPlayback.js nitter/public/js/infiniteScroll.js public/js/
scripts.prebuild: npm run init:upstream && npm run generate:version
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:health && wrangler pages deploy
